name: pocketsmart
description: PocketSmart AI - React + Express + Supabase budget planner

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.render:build: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --omit=dev --prefix backend
